title: Fixed Five-Room Trial Site
premise: A disposable synthetic site for comparing whole-adventure content on identical geometry.

rooms.name: Entrance
rooms.purpose: Introduce the site and observable evidence.

rooms.name: Gallery
rooms.purpose: Present evidence and a route choice.

rooms.name: Inner Hall
rooms.purpose: Resolve a puzzle using evidence available before the answer is needed.

rooms.name: Repository
rooms.purpose: Resolve the prepared objective and its consequences.

rooms.name: Side Annex
rooms.purpose: Offer an exploration challenge, the gate key and an optional secret bypass.
